description: Four fixed scripted player probes on the integrated policy. Passive command traces and changed objective/support states, with complete final-save equality against earlier unobserved replays. Not human validation.

definitions.episodes: One faction/mode/source/target/commander/started-day identity observed at replay loop boundaries. Transient states within a command can be absent; zero-day and final right-censored episodes remain explicit.
definitions.ready: Both recorded deficits reached zero at least once in the same observed preparation episode. Targets are recalculated; readiness can subsequently disappear and is not a departure promise.
definitions.campaignContinuation: The next observed objective becomes conquer for the same source/target; this is narrower than all actual campaign-committed trace events, which also include dispatches while primary defense continues.
definitions.support: Actual NPC requisition status changes and associated journeys. Initial manifests and terminal delivered cargo are preserved. These after-command snapshots do not establish donor stock immediately before dispatch.
definitions.decisionScope: Counters cover real campaign commands, including NPC tactical resolution inside them. Directly driven player-side AI calls are outside this trace. Every command trace has a 10000-event cap; no events were dropped in these four runs.

configuration.observation: Decision counters cover each real command. Objective events retain the bounded command trace; dropped events are reported explicitly. Objective/support history records changed states at loop boundaries, not every transient state within a command. History does not establish pre-dispatch donor conditions.
configuration.note: Exact reproduction of the existing diagnostic driver, including its omitted selected-side ration remainder. Actual campaign commands still charge real rations. No parameter tuning.
